name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for a kitchen renovation can range from several weeks to a few months. Smaller updates, such as painting and new countertops, will naturally be quicker. A complete kitchen overhaul involving layout changes, plumbing, and electrical work will take longer. Factors like material availability and the approval process for permits can also influence the project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen renovation can take several weeks to a few months, depending on the project's complexity.
